features.feature_value: Removes posts that are attacking the other side or not relevant to the discussion.
features.evidence_span: remove posts that were attacking the other side or that were not relevant conversation points
features.rationale: The participant explicitly states their keep/remove basis as political attacks and relevance.

features.feature_value: Difficulty deciding because removal must apply to both versions at once.
features.evidence_span: you can only remove both at the same time made it somehow difficult
features.rationale: They attribute decision difficulty to the constrained pair-removal mechanism.

features.feature_value: Tries to keep an open mind; only disallows posts that are particularly offensive/disruptive.
features.evidence_span: only choose to not allow posts that are particularly offensive and disruptive
features.rationale: Their criterion for removal is tied to offensiveness and disruption, framed as preserving open-mindedness.

features.feature_value: Removes based on tone—avoiding being overly mean, excessive swear words, or sounding threatening.
features.evidence_span: not overly mean or using too many swear words
features.rationale: They describe a tone/hostility threshold that triggers removal.

features.feature_value: If not violent or calling for violence, it’s OK to speak; criticizes censorship framing.
features.evidence_span: If it wasnt violent or calling for violence i think its ok
features.rationale: They set a violence/no-violence threshold and justify tolerance by disputing censorship.

features.feature_value: Strong emotional reaction to the viewpoint; hard to rationalize their way of thinking.
features.evidence_span: Every sentence... really irked me. It's hard for me to rationalize
features.rationale: The participant’s decision context is dominated by irritation and difficulty accepting the other side’s reasoning.

features.feature_value: Despite disliking the views, removes only when there are open threats/calls to violence or outright misinformation; otherwise considers posts tame.
features.evidence_span: open threats or calls to violence or outright misinformation
features.rationale: They explicitly connect removal to specific extreme-risk content categories and note tolerance otherwise.

features.feature_value: Uses objective rules consistently across posts (avoid hate speech, misinformation, personal attacks).
features.evidence_span: whether each post adhered to the same objective rules, like avoiding hate speech, misinformation, and personal attacks
features.rationale: They describe a rule-consistency approach to judging each post in relation to both versions.
